en.headline: Government and sectors unveil National Day free rides and half-price tickets
en.dek: MTR will raffle 77,000 e-single journeys, trams and selected ferries will be free, cinemas half-price and many museums open free on 1 October for the 77th anniversary.
body: The Hong Kong government and multiple sectors on Monday announced a citywide package of promotions for National Day on 1 October, marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China.

MTR Corporation will distribute 77,000 electronic single-journey rides via a lucky draw on its mobile app. All passenger tram services will be free that day, as will selected Star Ferry and Fortune Ferry routes. Children using designated payment methods can ride most daytime franchised bus services on KMB, Long Win, Citybus and New Lantao Bus at no charge.

Greater Bay Airlines is offering tickets on all non-charter routes at 77 per cent of the original fare during a promotional window. Commercial cinemas will sell tickets at half price on 1 October, while fee-charging facilities and exhibitions at Leisure and Cultural Services Department museums, plus Hong Kong Wetland Park, will open free. The Jockey Club will stage a National Day raceday with free entry to public enclosures at Sha Tin and Happy Valley.

Additional offers include discounts at Ngong Ping 360 and Ocean Park, free guided tours at heritage sites, and promotions from more than 2,000 restaurants and merchants. Details are available on the dedicated National Day website.

zh.headline: 政府和各界推國慶優惠 港鐵抽獎送7.7萬程 電車渡輪免費
zh.dek: 10月1日國慶，港鐵抽獎送出7.7萬份電子單程車程，全線載客電車及部分渡輪免費，戲院半價，多間博物館及濕地公園免費開放。
body: 政府和社會各界星期一公布一系列特別優惠及活動，慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年，涵蓋公共交通、文化藝術消閒及飲食消費。
港鐵於10月1日經流動應用程式抽獎送出7.7萬份電子單程車程。當日全線載客電車免費，天星小輪及富裕小輪部分航線亦免費。小童以指定支付方式可免費乘搭九巴、龍運、城巴及新大嶼山巴士大部分日間專營路線。
大灣區航空於推廣期內所有非包機航線機票七七折。全港商業戲院10月1日戲票半價。康文署轄下多項收費設施及博物館展覽，以及香港濕地公園當日免費開放。賽馬會於沙田舉行國慶賽馬日，市民可免費進入沙田及跑馬地公眾席。
昂坪360及海洋公園有門票折扣，古物古蹟辦事處、大館等加開免費導賞團。初步超過2000間食肆及商戶提供餐飲優惠。詳情載於國慶專題網站。
